about: PS4 exclusive bonus: - Static theme The ultimate edition of the latest major entry in the legendary RPG series!

The Definitive Edition includes all the content from the original release of the acclaimed DRAGON QUEST XI, and adds extra character-specific scenarios, the choice of playing with the original soundtrack or a grand orchestral version of the music…
Embark upon an epic adventure as The Luminary: the chosen one in a world that vows to hunt him down.
The Luminary and his unique band of loyal companions work together to survive an onslaught of ne’er-do-wells and overthrow the dark forces that plot to plunge the world of Erdrea into chaos.
Explore the massive world of DRAGON QUEST and awaken your power in this can't-miss adventure!
